# CERN Document Server (CDS)

> CERN Document Server (CDS) is CERN's institutional repository, built on InvenioRDM. It preserves and disseminates CERN research outputs, including publications, reports, datasets, software, departmental documents and multimedia. Records may be public or restricted. The repository is at https://repository.cern/ and its REST API is at https://repository.cern/api/.

Choose the access method that fits the task:

- **A known record:** `GET https://repository.cern/api/records/{record_id}`. Use the API, not the HTML landing page.
- **A search:** `GET https://repository.cern/api/records?q=...` with targeted queries (see the search guide below).
- **Communities:** `GET https://repository.cern/api/communities` and `/api/communities/{community_id}`.
- **Metadata harvesting:** use the OAI-PMH endpoint, not search pagination.
- **Citation:** send `Accept: text/x-bibliography` (optionally `?style=apa`) or `Accept: application/x-bibtex` to a record's API URL.
- **Depositing:** follow the documented submission workflow; deposits go to communities and may require curator review.

Rules for automated agents:

- Public records need no authentication. Restricted records, drafts and all write operations need authorized credentials. Use only credentials the user has explicitly provided for the task.
- Never bypass authentication, authorization, embargoes or access restrictions.
- Never publish, edit or delete content without explicit user authorization.
- Do not crawl HTML pages or use search pagination as a bulk-export mechanism.
- Send a descriptive, consistent `User-Agent`, avoid excessive parallel requests, back off on HTTP `429` and `5xx`, and honor `Retry-After`.
- For large-scale harvesting, contact CDS support first.
- CDS supports DOI registration through DataCite for eligible records. Depositors can request a DOI or provide an existing external DOI. Not all records receive a new CDS DOI.

## API

- [CDS API reference](https://repository.cern/docs/reference/reference/): REST APIs available on CDS
- [InvenioRDM REST API](https://inveniordm.docs.cern.ch/reference/rest_api_index/): endpoints, parameters, pagination, serialization formats and errors
- [InvenioRDM OpenAPI specification](https://inveniosoftware.github.io/invenio-openapi/): machine-readable API description
- [How to search](https://repository.cern/docs/search/search/): filters and advanced query syntax for `q=`
- [OAI-PMH endpoint](https://repository.cern/oai2d?verb=Identify): metadata harvesting
- [OAI-PMH sets](https://repository.cern/oai2d?verb=ListSets): available sets (one per community) for selective harvesting

## Depositing and access

- [Upload](https://repository.cern/docs/deposit/upload/): files, required metadata, DOIs
- [Submit to a community](https://repository.cern/docs/communities/submit/): choosing a community, metadata checks
- [Review process](https://repository.cern/docs/review/review/): curator review of submissions
- [Access & Share](https://repository.cern/docs/deposit/access-share/): access levels, embargoes, record versions
- [Published records](https://repository.cern/docs/deposit/published-records/): managing records after publication

## Policies

- [Content Policy](https://repository.cern/content-policy): what CDS accepts, withdrawal and removal
- [Terms and Conditions](https://repository.cern/terms)
- [Preservation Policy](https://repository.cern/preservation-policy)
- [Privacy Notice](https://cern.service-now.com/service-portal-old/privacy-policy-print.do?se=CDS-Service): Privacy notice for the CERN Document Server (CDS)

## Optional

- [FAQ](https://repository.cern/docs/faq/): Frequently asked questions covering DOIs, citations, access, communities, and record management
